name: Odoo
description: Odoo is a suite of open-source business apps that cover all your company needs.
composeYaml:
services:
  odoo:
    image: 'odoo:18'
    environment:
      - HOST=postgresql
      - USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - 'odoo-web-data:/var/lib/odoo'
      - 'odoo-extra-addons:/mnt/extra-addons'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8069'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
  postgresql:
    image: 'postgres:16-alpine'
    volumes:
      - 'postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=postgres
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d postgres'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
